# Sela 1.1
> Open-source JavaScript reader for PDF, reflowable EPUB, CBZ, TXT, Markdown, safe HTML, text-only FB2 and optional DjVu. Renderers load on demand. No Bootstrap or jQuery required.
- Demo: https://bobbyfch.github.io/sela/
- Source and installation: https://github.com/bobbyfch/sela
- Documentation: https://github.com/bobbyfch/sela/blob/main/docs/integrations.md
- Format scope: https://github.com/bobbyfch/sela/blob/main/docs/formats.md
- Proposed roadmap, not released features: https://github.com/bobbyfch/sela/blob/main/docs/roadmap.md
- License: MIT. PDF.js is Apache-2.0; PDFlipbook/fflate are MIT. External DjVu.js is GPL-2.0 and is not bundled.
- Modes: book, single, webtoon, manga (right-to-left).
- Privacy: selected demo files are read in the browser; the demo does not upload them.
- Compatibility: modern browsers; older browsers can open/download the original PDF. OS support depends on the browser.

- Optional tools: embedded contents, extractable-text search/transcript, browser TTS, page/chapter notes and JSON export/import. No OCR, aligned PDF text layer, CFI/highlights, sync, OPDS or MOBI/AZW3.
- Extension-only private bookshelf: IndexedDB, local cover extraction, multi-file import/deduplication, search, sort, rename/export/remove/undo, clock and coffee pause. Standard/New Tab Chromium and Firefox development packages; unsigned/not store-published. Optional origin permission for Open with Sela downloads. Pages is viewer-only.
- Overlay and inline presentation share capabilities; use presentation: inline and a connected container with explicit height.
- Sample: Yang Tidak Ikut Pulang, original 50-page Indonesian novelet, 12 chapters and real PDF bookmarks; complete EPUB; CBZ illustration gallery only. Story/illustrations CC BY 4.0, AI-assisted; fictional characters.
- Core release: 1.1.0. CDN https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/bobbyfch/sela@v1.1.0/dist/js/sela.min.js. FlippyPDF is retired; public CDN caches cannot be recalled.
- Privacy: first-visit Pages language lookup uses country.is IP-country service; ?geo=off disables. Embed library does not geolocate. Local narration default; online voices optional and may send text to provider.

- PWA: installable viewer shell with lazy same-origin engine cache, no bookshelf or document caching.
- Appearance: six accessible icon tabs, twelve filters, document brightness and dim controls.
- Extension update check: manual/daily stable-release notification, opt-out; unpacked ZIPs update manually.
- Security scope: no client-side anti-clone encryption; MIT attribution and SHA-256 provenance; local bookshelf is not application-encrypted.
